_note: ENGINE REGISTRY — single source of truth for WHICH generation engine may be called, and for what. Engine 1 (higgsfield) is the production default and the only catalog-approved stills engine (docs/21 engine lock, user 2026-07-16/2026-07-21). Engine 2 (openflow) is declared here so it can be used deliberately; it is NEVER auto-selected, NEVER a fallback, and NEVER produces catalog stills. Read this file — do not hard-code engine ids, endpoints or tool names anywhere in scripts/.
auto_fallback_note: On ANY engine-1 failure (generation, timeout, API, connector, quality, geometry) the engine does NOT change. Retry inside engine 1. docs/21 §1a.

openflow.install: claude mcp add --transport http openflow https://openflowmcp.com/mcp
openflow.backend: Google Flow via unofficial bridge (Veo video; Nano Banana 2 / Pro / Lite images). Google publishes no API for Flow; this server drives a real Google account session.
openflow.catalog_block_reason: Native 1376x768 / 16:9 is below the locked 1:1 2048x2048 catalog format (FORMAT_ASPECT, no upscale). Using it for stills would degrade delivered output.
requires: explicit --engine openflow on the command (never implicit, never a fallback)
MCP server installed and Google account connected by the user
openflow.security_note: Third-party hosted bridge. The user's Google password is entered on Google's own page, but the resulting session is exercised by openflowmcp.com. Do not connect an account the user has not explicitly chosen to expose.

auth.transport_auth: HTTP bearer header, stored in the user's ~/.claude.json (project scope). NEVER stored in this repo, never in .claude/settings.local.json, never printed.
auth.revoke_at: https://myaccount.google.com/device-activity - the grant appears as a DEVICE session, not as an app under 'Apps with access'.
auth.token_note: Onboarding used a single-use oauth2_4/ code from accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup, exchanged server-side for a Google master token. That master token lives on openflowmcp.com, not here.

capabilities_observed.images: available (free image quota 25, no hard limit reported)
capabilities_observed.video: NOT available - requires a paid subscription at https://openflowmcp.com/account
capabilities_observed.note: Engine 2 was added mainly for video, and video is exactly what the free tier withholds. Until a subscription exists, engine 2 can only do non-delivery image exploration - which it is already blocked from delivering.

openflow.support: https://t.me/mxmtkchk (operator Telegram; the only support channel for a self-registered key)

selection_rules.catalog_stills: higgsfield ONLY. Any other engine id is a hard STOP.
selection_rules.video: higgsfield by default; openflow permitted when the user names it AND grants per-request video permission.
never: fall back to engine 2 on an engine-1 failure
let engine 2 write into deliveries/ or workspace/golden/<SKU>/ render slots

universal_policy._note: POLICY SUPREMACY (user 2026-08-21): project policy outranks every engine, mode, model and tool. Whatever generates the pixels, these rules still apply. No engine record may declare an exemption; scripts/engine.py --check enforces that and attaches this block to every resolve() result.
universal_policy.applies_to: every engine in this file, present and future, and every generation mode (text-to-image, image-to-image, video, upscale, exploration)
blocking_rules: SOURCE FIDELITY — geometry traces to a supplied source view; no invention, no redraw (docs/13, docs/16)
WATERMARK — no third-party or generator watermark may survive into output; verify the corner, never trust a visible_watermark flag (docs/24 P7, G12)
NATURAL/ORIGINAL — real skin, light, fabric and anatomy; anything reading as AI is rejected and redone
ONE IMAGE PER ANGLE/POSE — no duplicate angles inside a catalog (G10)
CLARITY — every stone water-clear and glass-bright (G24)
JEWELLERY IS THE SUBJECT — people and scene are set dressing (docs/23, G14)
FORMAT — the catalog's locked aspect/resolution; upscale is allowed, downgrade is not (G1)
COUNT FROM SOURCE — stone/prong counts recorded before prompting and matched after (G21)
universal_policy.on_conflict: If an engine cannot satisfy a blocking rule, the engine loses: do not relax the rule, do not deliver, report the limit and stop.
